failure_summary.description: The restaurant search result was not assigned to a variable or saved to cache.
The agent repeated flight searches instead of retrieving and filtering each cached itinerary leg for the new class preference.

patch.reasoning: The skill already explicitly requires assigning and saving every result-producing call, and specifies retrieving, filtering, and saving cached results independently for multi-leg updates. These failures reflect nonadherence to existing guidance rather than a missing rule, so no edit is warranted.
